description: Planning landmarks derived from the wildfire-watch Gunnison / Crested Butte AOR notes and local project fixtures. Coordinates are approximate map anchors for analyst orientation, not surveyed operational coordinates.

landmarks.label: Crested Butte
landmarks.summary: Primary north-valley civic anchor and likely human review hub for wildfire-watch planning.

landmarks.label: Mount Crested Butte
landmarks.summary: Upper-valley population and terrain anchor near the East River and Gothic corridors.

landmarks.label: Gunnison
landmarks.summary: County-seat anchor for public-source context, airport coordination, and south-valley logistics.

landmarks.label: Gunnison-Crested Butte Regional Airport
landmarks.summary: KGUC airspace coordination anchor. The surrounding Class E/LAANC overlay remains a reference until FAA status is checked live.

landmarks.label: CBFPD Station Reference
landmarks.summary: Reference marker for fire-district coordination context. This workbench does not send notifications or dispatch messages.

landmarks.label: Slate River Drainage
landmarks.summary: High-fuel drainage zone with beetle-kill spruce/fir emphasis in the local wildfire-watch fixture.

landmarks.label: Cement Creek Drainage
landmarks.summary: Dispersed dead-timber planning zone southeast of Crested Butte.

landmarks.label: West Elk Wilderness No-Fly Reference
landmarks.summary: Hard no-fly reference marker matching the simplified exclusion overlay; authoritative USFS GIS is still required before any live operation.
